summary:
A light-gray canvas (#f1f1f1) holds one centred pair of feedback buttons. Together they look like a pill split in two by a 12 px gap: the left half (thumbs-up) runs x 174–354 and the right half (thumbs-down) runs x 366–546, both y 294–426. Each half is 180×132. Its outer end is a full semicircle (radius ~66) and its inner corners are only slightly rounded (~8 px). The fill is an off-white #f7f7f7 with a hairline gray border and a soft drop shadow underneath. Each half holds a solid black glyph about 60 px across. The thumbs-up points up and right; the thumbs-down is its mirror. A black macOS-style arrow cursor with a white outline acts out four clicks:
1. **Like on, ~0.45s.** The left half shrinks to about 0.9 scale. From 0.65s to 0.95s the glyph turns dark green, grows to about 2× and leaps up out of the button, its top reaching y≈203. Meanwhile a mint radial glow fills the button.
2. **Glyph lands, 1.0–1.25s.** The glyph drops back, turns bright green (#0dbc39) and settles on the glow.
3. **Like off, ~1.85s.** The button shrinks again. The glyph darkens to deep green, then black, and the glow fades. The button is neutral by 2.35s.
4. **Dislike on, ~2.95s.** The cursor moves to the right half and clicks. The button shrinks, and from 3.05s to 3.35s the glyph goes dark red, then bright red (#e5173f). It wobbles in place (it does not fly), and a pink radial glow fills the button.
5. **Dislike off, ~4.15s.** A second click darkens the red glyph back to black and clears the glow. Everything is neutral by 4.6s.

The only moving parts are the cursor, the press scale, the glyph colour, scale and position, and the glow.

criteria.check: The background is a flat light gray (~#f1f1f1) with no gradient or texture
Exactly two separate button halves sit side by side, centred in the frame
The left button spans about x 174–354, y 294–426 (≈180×132)
The right button spans about x 366–546, y 294–426 (≈180×132)
A gap of about 12 px separates the two buttons at x≈354–366
The left button's left end is a full semicircle (radius ≈66) and its right corners are only slightly rounded (≈8 px)
The right button mirrors this: its right end is a full semicircle and its left corners are only slightly rounded
At rest, the button fill is off-white (#f7f7f7), slightly lighter than the background, with a thin light-gray outline
A soft, diffuse gray shadow falls just below the bottom edge of both buttons
A solid black thumbs-up glyph about 60 px wide is centred in the left button near (270,353)
The thumbs-up is a filled silhouette (not an outline) with a separate rounded cuff on its left, divided from the hand by a light gap
A solid black thumbs-down glyph is centred in the right button near (450,366), with its thumb pointing down-left and its cuff on the right
A black arrow cursor with a white outline is visible below the buttons near (395,545)
The cursor travels from below the buttons (≈395,545) up onto the lower-right of the like button (≈325,400)
When clicked, the like button shrinks to about 0.9 scale (≈x 185–344, y 302–418) while the dislike button stays full size
Between 0.65s and 0.95s the thumbs-up leaps upward out of the button, its top rising from y≈325 to y≈203
While airborne, the thumbs-up grows to about twice its size (≈90–115 px tall vs ≈60 at rest)
At the top of its leap, the thumbs-up is dark forest green (~#0d5c1f), not black
At its peak, the enlarged thumbs-up overflows above the button's top edge (y 294) and is not clipped by it
The like button fills with a soft mint radial glow, strongest near the glyph and fading toward the button edges
Between 1.0s and 1.25s the thumbs-up drops back down and settles at its rest spot (top ≈325)
After landing, the thumbs-up is bright green (~#0dbc39) at rest size
While like is active, the dislike button stays off-white with a black glyph
A second click on the like button (≈1.85s) shrinks it again, and the glyph becomes dark green
After the second click the green glow fades out and the thumbs-up goes back to black at rest size
Turning like off does NOT launch the glyph upward; it stays inside the button
The cursor moves from the lower right (≈550,515) to the lower-left of the dislike button (≈410,410)
When clicked (≈2.95s), the dislike button briefly shrinks to about 0.9 scale
Mid-transition, the thumbs-down is dark crimson (~#8a1028)
During activation the thumbs-down wobbles in place (shifts ≈18 px left and slightly down, then back) but never leaves the button
Once active, the thumbs-down is bright red (~#e5173f) at rest size and position
The dislike button fills with a soft pink radial glow centred on the glyph
While dislike is active, the thumbs-up is plain black and its button has no green glow
The cursor rests off to the lower right, near (598,485)
A second click on dislike (≈4.15s) darkens the glyph to near-black red and the pink glow fades; by 4.6s the button is neutral again
The buttons themselves never change position across the clip; only the press scale changes
